messages:
talia: copy check for the account deletion confirmation modal. want it to be clear about what is removed and give an easy safe path. current draft below.

mohit: Current draft:
Title: Delete account?
Body: Deleting your account will remove your data. This action is permanent.
Primary: Delete account
Secondary: Cancel

talia: feels too terse and a bit scary. we should list what 'your data' includes and offer a non-destructive alternative like deactivation. also need to surface billing implications.

rowan: agree. recommend explicit list: workspaces, API keys, usage history, billing. and clarify refunds: "Your subscription won't be refunded automatically; contact support."

mohit: suggestion (concise):
Body: This will permanently delete your account, including workspaces, API keys, and usage history. Your active subscription won’t be canceled automatically.
Primary: Permanently delete account
Secondary: Deactivate account instead

accessibility-bot: a11y note: avoid using only 'Permanently' as the label for the primary button. include the noun for context and an aria-label that repeats the count/details: e.g., 'Permanently delete account and all workspaces'. Focus should go to the modal heading on open.

talia: also consider tone: "We’ll miss you" is too friendly for a security action. keep neutral and helpful. Provide a small link to export data and a tiny line about support contact for billing.

rowan: propose final modal copy:
Title: Permanently delete account
Body: This will permanently delete your account and all associated data (workspaces, API keys, logs, and usage history). Your active subscription will remain unless canceled. To keep a copy of your data, export it first. For billing help, contact support@redwood.ai.
Primary: Permanently delete account
Secondary: Deactivate account
Link (small): Export data

mohit: microcopy nit: use sentence case in body and short sentences. replace 'logs' with 'audit logs' where applicable. also ensure the Export link opens in a new tab and is keyboard accessible.

accessibility-bot: additional a11y checklist: if account has live deployments, show a conditional warning: 'Active deployments will stop serving when account is deleted.' Provide a typed confirmation only for accounts with organization-level roles. Provide aria-describedby for the export link and ensure focus trap inside modal.

talia: love it. i'll update Figma with the revised copy, add the conditional warning for active deployments, and add aria-labels and typed confirmation only for org admins. i'll file a short copy ticket and ping PM. if no objections, i'll land this by EOD. :thumbsup:

mohit: :+1:

rowan: LGTM. small ask: change 'support@redwood.ai' to a help center link where possible.

talia: done, updated to links and Figma now reflects all accessibility notes. thanks!
